Name: Hunt: Elder Ashta at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: An Elder Ashta has denned at the <Alias=TargetLocation>, out past the city walls. Put it down before it starts coming in.

LogEntries.Entry: An Ashta bigger and older than the rest has taken the <Alias=TargetLocation> for its den, out past Akila City's walls. The Rangers want it put down before it starts coming in.
I met the Ranger on the edge of the <Alias=TargetLocation>. It's an Ashta den, and the old one in there has been taking stock. I need to go in quiet and put it down.
I tracked the Elder Ashta to its den at the <Alias=TargetLocation> and put it down.

Objectives.DisplayText: Meet the Ranger on the edge of the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Hunt the Elder Ashta at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You came out. The old one's had that den longer than I've been a Ranger. Every Ashta on Akila hunts at night. This one hunts in daylight too. Ask what you need, then go in quiet.
Good. It'll know you're there before you see it, so don't stop moving.
Crangon off the plains, mostly. Then a homestead's stock last week. Once they learn stock doesn't run, they don't go back to crangon.
Do they all get this old?
No. Most of them die young out here. Now and then one doesn't, and somebody behind the walls in Akila City swears they saw one the size of a house.
Because there's one of me and a lot of Akila to watch. And the last old one I went after alone, I nearly didn't walk back from.
How do you know it's old?
The size, and the scars. An Ashta that lives this long doesn't run from anything on Akila, us included.
Keep your voice down. That's an Ashta den in there.
That's the old one down. I'll tell the homesteads they can let their stock out again.
